text:
jess: quick check — where's the canonical dashboard for TTFT p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec by host/model? trying to tune alerts for shared capacity.

oliver: Grafana -> Inference / Latency / TTFT breakdown. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inf-ttft/ttft-breakdown (panels: 'TTFT by host', 'TTFT by model', 'Tokens/sec by host').

sam: for tokens/sec use the panel that queries `rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])` and buckets by host. we call it "tokenrate-by-host".

jess: thanks. any recommended promql snippets for p95/p99?

oliver: yeah, two useful ones: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, host))` and similarly for 0.99. if you want it by model: add `, model` to the `by(...)`.

natasha: also check the TTFT warmup slice: `request_duration_seconds{route="/v1/generate",phase="first_token"}` — we saw some cold-start spikes in eu-west last week.

sam: if you're tuning alerts, consider splitting by customer tier. for shared-low we had noisy p99s during bulk-batch windows. proposal: raise the p99 alert threshold from 600ms -> 900ms for shared-low and add a higher-rate condition so we don't suppress real regressions.

jess: can you paste a concrete alert expr? I'll open a PR.

sam: sure, rough example:```yaml
alert: InferenceTTFTP99High
expr: |
  (
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, host, tier))
    > 0.9
  ) and on(host, tier) (increase(requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]) > 20)
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "TTFT p99 > 900ms for tier {{ $labels.tier }}"
```

oliver: that's a good start. also add `unless up{job="inference"} == 0` so the alert doesn't fire during host outages.

oncall_bot: FYI — recent alert flood (TTFT p99) on 1945672000 was traced to model-quantize rollout, see incident thread: https://redwood.incidents/1945672000

jess: perfect. I'll open the CR and link the dashboards + the jaeger trace sample. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/1422

natasha: for tracing, sample trace in Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/abc123 — look for a long `kv-cache` span, that was the pattern yesterday.

jess: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll ping when the CR is up for review. :thumbsup:
